[attribute-list-content]
=== `@list-content` List Content

Type of list, usually with a semantically meaningful name (for example, a “`where-list`” for the list of the variables that follows an equation, a “`notation-list`”, or a “`procedure-list`” for a list of procedural steps to follow).

#### Usage/Remarks
Preserves any semantic information concerning a _named_ type of list, for those instances where a standards organization’s proprietary tag set models specific named lists instead of the more generic element <<element-list,`<list>`>>.
Potential values for this attribute include, but are not limited to: “`procedure`”, “`where-list`” (used in equations), “`synonymy`”, “`compound-info`”, “`algorithm`”, “`notation`”, “`variable-list`”, etc.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-def-list,`<def-list>`>>, 
                  <<element-list,`<list>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type of list for named list types, for example, a
                        “`where-list`” for a list of the variables that frequently
                        follows an equation, a “`notation`” list, or a
                        “`procedure-list`” or
                        “`step-list`” for a list of procedural steps to
                        follow.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
